readings.commitment: The Basic Law's core is Article 1 under Article 79(3): human dignity inviolable and the clause itself beyond amendment — a constitution with an unamendable floor
readings.delta: Suppression of constitutional politics at the core (no majority reaches it); beneficiary is the dignity-holder against every future; victim set is total-revision sovereignty theory; extractiveness of the person constitutionally priced at infinity

readings.commitment: The Basic Law is militant: it arms the order against democracy's enemies with party bans and rights forfeiture, refusing Weimar's neutrality toward its own destroyers
readings.delta: Suppression aimed at anti-constitutional movements; beneficiary is the free democratic basic order; victim set is parties adjudged hostile to it; extractiveness of legality denied to legality's enemies

readings.commitment: The Basic Law is federal bone-deep: Länder with constitutional status, a Bundesrat of governments inside the legislature, federalism itself eternity-protected
readings.delta: Suppression of unitary recentralization; beneficiary is Land governments and regional difference; victim set is uniform national policy speed; extractiveness of central control conditioned on chamber-of-governments consent

readings.commitment: The Basic Law leads with rights: Articles 1 through 19 before any state organ, directly binding all public power, with the essence of each right untouchable
readings.delta: Suppression of rights-free zones of state action; beneficiary is every rights-holder including against private power's reach; victim set is unreviewable administration; extractiveness conditioned on proportionality throughout

readings.commitment: The Basic Law is a record of managed revision: rearmament, emergency powers, reunification, asylum, and the debt brake — each crisis written into the text by supermajority
readings.delta: Suppression of extra-constitutional adaptation (changes go through Article 79); beneficiary is textual continuity under change; victim set is informal-mutation constitutionalism; extractiveness of each settlement bargained at two-thirds

readings.commitment: Article 79(3) means what it says: dignity, democracy, and federal statehood are beyond every amendment majority forever — the constitution's self-binding is real
readings.delta: Suppression of constitutional suicide; beneficiary is the protected core's beneficiaries in perpetuity; victim set is unlimited pouvoir constituant; extractiveness of the core removed from politics entirely

readings.commitment: Article 1 anchors positive law in something prior: dignity is recognized, not granted, the post-Nuremberg insistence that legality alone had proven insufficient
readings.delta: Suppression of pure positivism; beneficiary is claims that outrank enacted law; victim set is law-is-law obedience doctrine; extractiveness of the person ungoverned by enactment

readings.commitment: Dignity plus eternity equals Karlsruhe: an untouchable clause needs an authoritative interpreter, and the Constitutional Court's supremacy grew from exactly that seed
readings.delta: Suppression of legislative final say; beneficiary is the Federal Constitutional Court; victim set is parliamentary constitutional interpretation; extractiveness of constitutional meaning concentrated in one bench

readings.commitment: Article 21's party ban is militant democracy's sharpest tool: parties seeking to impair the free democratic order are unconstitutional, by Karlsruhe's judgment alone
readings.delta: Suppression of anti-system party competition; beneficiary is the constitutional order's stability; victim set is banned parties and their voters; extractiveness of political organization denied to the order's enemies

readings.commitment: Article 18 lets fighters against the order forfeit their rights: free speech and assembly withdrawn from those who abuse them to destroy freedom — a clause never once successfully applied
readings.delta: Suppression individual and conditional, dormant in practice (every application failed); beneficiary is the order in theory; victim set is targeted agitators in theory; extractiveness of the threat symbolic, its disuse the finding

readings.commitment: Militant democracy is Weimar's autopsy made doctrine: the neutral republic let its enemies use its freedoms to kill it, and Bonn resolved never to be neutral about itself again
readings.delta: Suppression justified by remembered collapse; beneficiary is the second republic's survival; victim set is value-neutral proceduralism; extractiveness of tolerance bounded by self-preservation

readings.commitment: The SRP and KPD bans set the instrument's founding shape: neo-Nazi and communist parties dissolved in the fifties, the doctrine proven on both flanks at once
readings.delta: Suppression executed early and symmetrically; beneficiary is the young republic's center; victim set is both anti-system flanks; extractiveness of extremist organization interdicted at the founding

readings.commitment: The NPD judgment refined the bar: hostility to the order is not enough without the potential to achieve it — unconstitutional aims, too weak to ban
readings.delta: Suppression conditioned on capability, not creed alone; beneficiary is marginal extremism's legal existence; victim set is ban-on-ideology theory; extractiveness of the instrument reserved for real threats

readings.commitment: The ban power chills beyond its use: surveillance, funding exclusion, and the standing possibility of dissolution discipline the edges of politics without a single judgment
readings.delta: Suppression operating through anticipation; beneficiary is the bounded political spectrum; victim set is radical-but-legal opposition; extractiveness of dissent taxed by monitoring

readings.commitment: The Bundesrat puts governments inside lawmaking: Land executives voting en bloc on federal statutes, a federalism of entangled administrations rather than separated spheres
readings.delta: Suppression of unilateral federal legislation in consent matters; beneficiary is Land executives as co-legislators; victim set is clear accountability lines; extractiveness of policy passed through intergovernmental bargain

readings.commitment: The Länder keep the soul: education, culture, policing, and broadcasting are Land matters, the federation forbidden from the formation of minds
readings.delta: Suppression of national cultural policy; beneficiary is regional difference and sixteen school systems; victim set is mobility and uniformity interests; extractiveness of central identity-shaping forbidden

readings.commitment: German federalism drifted cooperative: joint tasks, shared taxes, and entangled financing webbed the levels together until no one governs alone and no one is blamable alone
readings.delta: Suppression of competitive federalism; beneficiary is consensus machinery; victim set is reform speed and accountability; extractiveness diffused through the joint-decision trap

readings.commitment: Lüth made the catalog an objective order of values: rights radiate into private law and every legal relation, not just the citizen-state line
readings.delta: Suppression of rights-free private ordering; beneficiary is rights-bearers in horizontal relations; victim set is pure private autonomy doctrine; extractiveness of private power constitutionally tempered

readings.commitment: The catalog's method is proportionality: suitable, necessary, and proportionate in the narrow sense — every limitation of every right run through the same four-step mill
readings.delta: Suppression of unweighed limitation; beneficiary is claimants with weighable interests; victim set is categorical rules either way; extractiveness of rights and regulation alike calibrated case by case

readings.commitment: Article 19(2) guards the essence: whatever balancing takes, no right may be hollowed to nothing — a kernel inside each guarantee that proportionality cannot reach
readings.delta: Suppression of death-by-balancing; beneficiary is each right's minimum core; victim set is unlimited optimization logic; extractiveness of the core off the scales

readings.commitment: The census judgment minted a new right from old text: informational self-determination, dignity and personality applied to data decades before the technology matured
readings.delta: Suppression of unconsented data processing; beneficiary is the surveilled individual; victim set is collection-hungry administration and industry; extractiveness of personal data conditioned on control

readings.commitment: Proportionality is structured public reason: four questions in fixed order that force the state to show its work whenever it burdens anyone
readings.delta: Suppression of unreasoned burden; beneficiary is the burdened with a forum; victim set is fiat administration; extractiveness justified step by visible step

readings.commitment: Proportionality is Germany's most successful export: the four-step test now runs constitutional review from Canada to South Africa to Strasbourg
readings.delta: Suppression of rival review methods abroad; beneficiary is a common grammar of rights; victim set is categorical-rule traditions (the American outlier); extractiveness of doctrine diffused worldwide

readings.commitment: Proportionality's last step is a scale without weights: 'proportionate in the narrow sense' dresses judicial preference as measurement, say its critics from Schmitt to Habermas's heirs
readings.delta: Suppression of rule-bound predictability; beneficiary is the balancing judge's discretion; victim set is legal certainty; extractiveness of outcomes determined where the method runs out

readings.commitment: The 1956 defense amendments rearmed the republic inside the constitution: a parliamentary army with a citizen-in-uniform doctrine, ten years after demilitarization
readings.delta: Suppression of the demilitarized founding premise; beneficiary is alliance integration and the new Bundeswehr; victim set is pacifist constitutionalism; extractiveness of military service reintroduced under parliamentary leash

readings.commitment: The 1968 emergency constitution filled the sovereignty gap: crisis powers written in against fierce protest, ending Allied reserved rights by giving the state its own exception
readings.delta: Suppression of normal procedure in declared states of tension and defense; beneficiary is governmental capacity in crisis; victim set is the extra-parliamentary opposition's trust; extractiveness of emergency bounded by joint-committee design

readings.commitment: Reunification came by accession: Article 23 absorbed the East into the Basic Law's existing order, and the promised all-German constitutional moment of Article 146 never happened
readings.delta: Suppression of the constituent-assembly path; beneficiary is West German institutional continuity; victim set is Eastern co-authorship of the shared order; extractiveness of transformation borne asymmetrically by the acceded

readings.commitment: The 1993 asylum compromise rebuilt Article 16: the unqualified individual right narrowed by safe-third-country rules, the founding generosity traded against arrival numbers
readings.delta: Suppression of the unconditional asylum claim; beneficiary is migration-control policy; victim set is claimants routed to 'safe' transit states; extractiveness of protection conditioned on route

readings.commitment: The 2009 debt brake constitutionalized fiscal limits: structural deficits capped in the text itself, budget discipline promoted from politics to higher law
readings.delta: Suppression of deficit finance by constitutional ceiling; beneficiary is future taxpayers and bond credibility; victim set is countercyclical and investment spending; extractiveness across generations capped, critics say strangled

readings.commitment: 1990 was accession, not merger: the GDR joined the Federal Republic's existing legal order whole, five new Länder under an unchanged Basic Law
readings.delta: Suppression of constitutional renegotiation; beneficiary is Western legal continuity and speed; victim set is two-state co-creation models; extractiveness of transition concentrated eastward

readings.commitment: Article 146 still stands: the Basic Law contemplates its own replacement by a constitution the whole people adopts — reunification used the other door and left this one ajar
readings.delta: Suppression of finality (the text names its successor's path); beneficiary is constituent-power theory; victim set is Basic-Law-as-permanent readings; extractiveness of the unasked referendum an open account

readings.commitment: Reunification was done by treaty: the Unification Treaty's hundreds of pages did the real constitutional work, amendment by international instrument ratified at two-thirds
readings.delta: Suppression of ordinary amendment visibility (the change came packaged); beneficiary is negotiated detail and transition schedules; victim set is clause-by-clause deliberation; extractiveness of terms set at the treaty table

readings.commitment: The debt brake is credibility made law: a constitutional commitment device against the deficit bias every legislature carries
readings.delta: Suppression of structural borrowing; beneficiary is long-run solvency and the bond market's trust; victim set is present-biased budgeting; extractiveness from future taxpayers capped at the text

readings.commitment: The debt brake starves the future to protect it: rails, grids, and schools decay under a rule that counts borrowing but not the assets it would buy
readings.delta: Suppression of debt-financed investment alongside consumption; beneficiary is the accounting rule; victim set is infrastructure and growth; extractiveness of deferred maintenance compounding off the books

readings.commitment: The debt brake governs by its exceptions: emergency clauses for pandemic and war, special funds beside the budget — the rule survives by the holes punched in it
readings.delta: Suppression formally intact, practically negotiated; beneficiary is crisis spending through side doors; victim set is the rule's transparency premise; extractiveness rerouted through off-budget vehicles
